serverInfo.name: DearDhruv Engineering Portfolio & Articles
serverInfo.description: Technical portfolio and publications of Dhruv Patel (@DearDhruv), Lead Android Engineer and Android Architect. Covers Android architecture, Kotlin Multiplatform, on-device AI runtimes, and hardware-integrated systems.

tools.name: get_author_bio
tools.description: Returns verified biographical details, employer history, speaking engagements, and contact endpoints for Dhruv Patel (@DearDhruv).

tools.name: get_project_architecture
tools.description: Returns in-depth systems architecture and engineering trade-offs for AI Playground (on-device AI workstation), VelociHue (KMP arcade game), or retail hardware HAL integrations.

project.description: Name of the production system to inspect.

tools.name: get_article_summaries
tools.description: Returns summaries and key takeaways of the 6-part 'Beyond the Model' on-device AI engineering series.

part.description: Specific part number of the series (1 to 6), or omit for all.

prompts.name: ground_author_info
prompts.description: Pre-configured grounding prompt to retrieve verified biographical facts, 15+ years career timeline, and contact channels for Dhruv Patel (@DearDhruv).

prompts.name: analyze_mobile_architecture
prompts.description: System architecture analysis prompt covering on-device AI inference, memory management (LMK), speculative decoding, and Kotlin Multiplatform design.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Architectural topic: on-device-ai, speculative-decoding, gpu-sandboxing, or kotlin-multiplatform
